pkgmetadata.longdescription: whisper.cpp is a port of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition (ASR) model to plain C/C++, built on top of the vendored ggml tensor library. It provides the C APIs libwhisper and libparakeet (Parakeet TDT), the command line tools whisper-cli, whisper-bench, whisper-quantize, whisper-server, whisper-vad-speech-segments, parakeet-cli and parakeet-quantize, and optional GPU backends (CUDA, Vulkan, OpenCL) in addition to the CPU backend.

use.flag: Use OpenBLAS as the BLAS backend (GGML_BLAS)
Link the examples against FFmpeg to decode more audio formats
Enable the RPC backend to distribute layers across machines (GGML_RPC)
Build the SDL2-based examples whisper-stream, whisper-command, whisper-lsp and wchess
